decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today with the NASDAQ down 0.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.3% — no strong risk-on signal to justify deploying new capital. Cash on hand ($489.29) sits just below the $500 threshold, so per strategy guidance we're holding rather than forcing a buy. Existing positions are being held through this low-conviction day; stop-losses and profit targets remain in place automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 slipped modestly today, down 0.5% and 0.3% respectively, in a broadly directionless session. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move — trading reflected general consolidation rather than a sharp risk-off event. With no strong momentum signal in either direction, this was a day for holding rather than acting.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納指及標普500指數均輕微下跌，分別下跌0.5%及0.3%，市場走勢欠缺方向性。今日並無明顯單一因素主導市場，走勢較似整固而非明顯的risk-off事件。由於缺乏強烈的動能訊號，今日屬於觀望而非出手的日子。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept in reserve so you can act decisively when a real opportunity appears, instead of spending it just because it's sitting idle. Today's cash balance was below the buy threshold and the market gave no strong risk-on signal, so holding that cash was the disciplined choice rather than a wasted one.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留現金，待真正機會出現時才果斷出手，而非因為現金閒置就隨便動用。今日現金餘額未達買入門檻，市場亦未發出明確的risk-on訊號，因此持有現金才是有紀律的做法，而非浪費機會。
